gameDescriptionHtml:
Traders Life Together is a game about running your own supermarket with your friends, it presents a set of features to provide a satisfying gameplay experience

Game Features

  • Realistic buying system of products where players need to drive their vehicles to wholesalers and transport their goods back to the shop
  • Multiple wholesalers: Butcher, vegetable shop, electronics shop, toys shop, shoes shop, Grocery shop
  • Dynamic Economy: Daily changing prices of products
  • Realistic product placing system on shelves to give the players more space to create their own shop style
  • Full freedom of placing the shelves / furniture inside the shop / home
  • Survival aspects where player manage their vital status
  • Driving: Variety of vehicles are available to purchase
  • Five vehicles to be purchased from NPCs
  • Interactive NPCs
  • Placement grid and snap system
  • A Large Variety of products
  • A Large Variety of shelves, store appliances and furniture to be bought to customize the shop available in the furniture shop
  • Three Shop Expansions and installable shop sign are available
  • Shop Reputation system that when increased attracts more customers to come to the shop and buy larger numbers of products
  • House / shop decorations
  • Day / night cycle
